items.name: Avocado Toast
items.description: Toasted artisan bread topped with smashed avocado, cherry tomatoes, microgreens, and a poached egg.

items.name: Classic Eggs Benedict
items.description: English muffin topped with Canadian bacon, poached eggs, and hollandaise sauce. Served with breakfast potatoes.

items.name: Buttermilk Pancakes
items.description: Fluffy pancakes served with maple syrup, butter, and your choice of fresh berries or banana.

items.name: Grilled Salmon Salad
items.description: Grilled salmon fillet over mixed greens with cucumber, red onion, cherry tomatoes, and lemon dill vinaigrette.

items.name: Bistro Burger
items.description: Angus beef patty with aged cheddar, caramelized onions, lettuce, tomato, and special sauce on a brioche bun. Served with fries.

items.name: Chicken Pesto Sandwich
items.description: Grilled chicken breast with pesto, mozzarella, roasted red peppers, and arugula on ciabatta bread. Served with mixed greens.

items.name: Filet Mignon
items.description: 8oz filet with red wine reduction, garlic mashed potatoes, and seasonal vegetables.

items.name: Lobster Risotto
items.description: Creamy Arborio rice with butter-poached lobster, asparagus, and parmesan.

items.name: Truffle Mushroom Pasta
items.description: Fettuccine with wild mushrooms, truffle oil, garlic, white wine, and parmesan cheese.

items.name: Pan-Seared Scallops
items.description: Sea scallops with lemon butter sauce, cauliflower puree, and crispy pancetta.

items.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
items.description: Warm chocolate cake with a molten center, served with vanilla ice cream and fresh berries.

items.name: Crème Brûlée
items.description: Classic vanilla bean custard with a caramelized sugar crust.

items.name: New York Cheesecake
items.description: Creamy cheesecake with a graham cracker crust, topped with seasonal fruit compote.

items.name: Signature Martini
items.description: House-infused citrus vodka, elderflower liqueur, and fresh lemon juice. Served with a twist.

items.name: Artisanal Cold Brew
items.description: Slow-steeped for 24 hours for a smooth, rich flavor. Served over ice.

items.name: Raspberry Mojito
items.description: Fresh muddled raspberries, mint, lime juice, rum, and soda water.
